# Claude Daily Memory

Claude Daily Memory turns useful results from Claude Code sessions, terminals, and projects into a continuously growing NotebookLM knowledge base.

Canonical website (English): https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/
Russian website: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/ru/
Source repository: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory
README: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory/blob/main/README.md
Security policy: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory/security/policy
License: Apache-2.0
Language: Python 3.11+

## Main job to be done

Useful context disappears when a Claude Code session ends and becomes fragmented when several terminals or projects are active. Claude Daily Memory preserves selected decisions, plans, findings, reports, and unfinished threads in one structured daily record. It maintains that record in a Google Doc that the user can add to NotebookLM as a standard Drive source.

The accumulated source lets the user apply NotebookLM capabilities to ongoing work: search past decisions, recover reasoning, compare projects, prepare return-to-project briefings, identify repeated problems and dependencies, and create outputs supported by the user's NotebookLM account.

## Product boundary

Claude Daily Memory supplies and maintains the source. NotebookLM remains the place where the user searches, analyzes, connects, and transforms the accumulated knowledge. The project does not use an unofficial consumer NotebookLM API, browser cookies, or Playwright login automation. Normal NotebookLM source synchronization or refresh behavior still applies.

## Safety and architecture facts

- Aggregates safe activity from multiple Claude Code terminals and projects.
- Includes curated Markdown outcomes and high-level activity counts.
- Never reads raw Claude Code transcript JSONL files.
- Excludes full prompts, full responses, commands, tool input/output, Gmail content, and arbitrary files from automatic memory.
- Scans every selected artifact and the complete digest before network access.
- Fails closed on suspicious content, malformed input, scanner errors, missing credentials, or update conflicts.
- Creates a local Markdown archive before optional cloud export.
- Uses official Google Drive and Docs APIs with `drive.file`.
- Stores refresh tokens in the operating-system Secret Service.
- Keeps optional Gmail cleanup and Gemini tools separate from daily memory.
- Gmail cleanup supports reversible Trash moves only; permanent deletion is unsupported.
- Gemini accepts only explicitly supplied text and cannot discover Gmail, Drive, project files, memory, or clipboard content.
